title: Korea Eximbank Exchange Rates
description: Manage official exchange rate updates and run history.
time_hint: The Export-Import Bank of Korea publishes rates around 11:00 KST on business days, so an update time of 11:00 or later is recommended. On non-business days, the previous business day's rates remain in effect.
date_range_invalid: The end date is earlier than the start date. Select the period again.

hints.notify_on_failure: Sent when an exchange rate update fails (for example, an authentication error or the daily limit being exceeded). If the task itself fails to run, the schedule's “Failure notification” in Schedule Management notifies you separately.

notification_definitions.reset_success: Notification has been reset to default.

reset_modal.title: Reset to Default
reset_modal.confirm_message: All channel templates of this notification will be restored to defaults.
reset_modal.warning_message: The saved subject, body, and recipient settings will be permanently lost.

read_only: You have read-only access. Managing settings and updating rates require management permission.
plugin_read_only: You do not have permission to change this plugin's settings, so they are shown read-only.

schedule.title: Update schedule
schedule.managed_hint: Set the run days in “Run days” on this screen, and the update time and frequency in Schedule Management.
schedule.inactive: The rate update schedule is turned off, so rates are not updated automatically. Turn it on in Schedule Management.
schedule.missing: The rate update schedule is not registered yet. Update the plugin or check Schedule Management.

channel_template_missing: No template for this channel — nothing will be sent
settings_forbidden: You do not have permission to view plugin settings, so the settings could not be loaded or saved.
notifications_forbidden: You do not have permission to view notification settings, so the failure notification list could not be loaded.
